# Distill

> Distill is a wellness app that finds out which of your health habits work on your body, using the data your wearable already collects, and tells you which ones you can stop doing and stop paying for.

- You list your stack: supplements with doses, devices, services, memberships, routines and timings. Distill counts and costs it.
- On day one, each item lands in one of four places: can come off today with no test (dose below what studies used, a form the body doesn't absorb, tested and found nothing, no known way it could work, does the same job as something else, or not being used); worth testing on you; can't be measured, your call; or yours (anything from a clinician, never rated).
- The first week, it only watches, to learn your normal.
- It tests one habit at a time for 14 nights, 3 nights on and 3 off, with one tap a day.
- Each test ends in a verdict in real units against your own normal night-to-night swing: kept, dropped, or inconclusive.
- Works with Oura, Apple Watch (through Apple Health) and Garmin. WHOOP is not supported yet.
- Wellness, not medical advice. It never diagnoses or treats anything.
- Price: $20 a month, no lock-in. The Founding 100 keep $20 a month for life. If no test lands a verdict within 60 days of the first one, you don't pay.
- Status: pre-launch waitlist.
